meta.title: Suggested vendors are added via Invite Vendors

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow, whose default stage is Auction.
Provide the required event title so the auction can be published.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding products.
Add a product whose mapped vendors drive the suggested-vendor invitation.
Complete the auction pricing sheet for the added product.
Click the product-provided Invite Vendors action so all vendors mapped to the added product are automatically added.
Commit a valid event schedule required for publishing.
Publish the auction so its participant list can be inspected.
Confirm the auction was created successfully.
Open the published auction's participant list.
Verify that the mapped suggested vendors were added as participants.
